context: A couple sorts out paperwork from a service provider at home
purpose: Teach: 郵送/口頭/卸売/呼び出し/要旨/契機/有意義/増殖

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 電力会社から書類が郵送で届いてたよ。料金プランの見直しの件。
lines.en: Documents came by mail from the power company. About reviewing our rate plan.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact household tone, slightly tired

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ああ、先週担当の人が来たとき、口頭でもざっと説明してくれた話だな。
lines.en: Ah, that's what the rep also explained verbally when he came by last week.
lines.style: Relaxed husband voice, leaning back in chair

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 要旨だけ言うと、卸売市場の電力価格が上がって、家庭向けも値上げするって内容。
lines.en: Just the gist — wholesale market electricity prices rose, so household rates are going up too.
lines.style: Summarizing patiently while scanning the page

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: なるほど。この前の呼び出しの電話も、その値上げの件が契機だったのかもな。
lines.en: I see. That call asking us to come in earlier might've been triggered by this rate hike too.
lines.style: Connecting the dots, mildly impressed tone

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 需要ばっかり増殖するように伸びて、供給が追いついてないって、グラフまで付いてる。
lines.en: Demand keeps multiplying like crazy but supply can't keep up — there's even a graph attached.
lines.style: Slightly exasperated tone, holding up the paper

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: じゃあ週末に二人でちゃんと読んでみよう。家計にとっては有意義な話し合いになりそうだ。
lines.en: Then let's read through it properly this weekend. Should be a meaningful talk for the family budget.
lines.style: Warm, suggesting a shared task with a gentle smile

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん、お茶でも淹れて、ゆっくりね。返送の期限は来月の十日までだって。
lines.en: Yeah, I'll brew some tea and we'll take our time. The return deadline is the tenth of next month.
lines.style: Soft, agreeable, already thinking ahead practically
